<style>
/* Grade responsiva: 3 cards por linha no desktop */
.team-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:24px;
  align-items:start;
}

/* Ajustes para telas médias e pequenas */
@media (max-width: 980px){
  .team-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
}
@media (max-width: 640px){
  .team-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
}

/* Card */
.profile-card{
  text-align:center;
  padding:16px;
  border-radius:16px;
  background:#fff;
}

/* Foto redonda */
.profile-card .avatar{
  width:160px; height:160px;
  border-radius:50%;
  object-fit:cover; object-position:center;
  display:block; margin:0 auto 12px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
}

/* Tipografia */
.profile-card h3{
  margin:6px 0 0;
  font-size:1.05rem;
}
.profile-card .role{
  margin:6px 0 0;
  color:#555;
  line-height:1.35;
  font-size:.95rem;
}
</style>
